findings.title: Feature-enabled dashboard tables discard their query results
findings.body: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, this branch renders `TableWidgetVisualization` with `columns: []` and empty `data`/`meta` instead of the current `result` values. Dashboard table widgets therefore appear blank for every organization using the new visualization, even when their queries return data.

findings.title: Age/timestamp validation accepts invalid combinations
findings.body: These checks use truthiness rather than field presence, so a report containing both `age: 0` and a timestamp (or `timestamp: 0` and an age) passes despite the mutual-exclusion rule. The serializer also accepts reports containing neither field, although the supported report formats require one of them. Use presence-based cross-field validation and require exactly one format field so malformed reports are rejected.

findings.title: Error details can be associated with the wrong event ID
findings.body: `get_multi` returns results keyed by node ID, but this zips the original IDs with the mapping's values, relying on positional order and on missing nodes being retained. If a requested node is missing, or the mapping order differs from the request order, an event's details are labeled with another event's ID. This can place errors at the wrong timestamp and send mismatched error context to the replay summarizer; associate each result with its node ID explicitly.
